# Survey

Google-Forms-style question cards: an eyebrow, a title with an optional required asterisk, and an answer. Survey owns the layout and semantics; the controls are the real DS components.

```tsx
<SurveyQuestion required className="max-w-xl">
  <SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyEyebrow>Question 1</SurveyEyebrow>
    <SurveyTitle>How do you build UI today?</SurveyTitle>
  </SurveyHeader>
  <SurveyOptions defaultValue="shared">
    <SurveyOption value="shared">A shared internal component library</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="kit">An off-the-shelf UI kit</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="handrolled">Hand-rolled components in each project</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="mixed">A mix, depending on the team</SurveyOption>
  </SurveyOptions>
</SurveyQuestion>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli add survey
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/survey/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import {
  SurveyQuestion,
  SurveyHeader,
  SurveyEyebrow,
  SurveyTitle,
  SurveyOptions,
  SurveyOption,
} from "@/components/ui/survey"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <SurveyQuestion required>
      <SurveyHeader>
        <SurveyEyebrow>Question 1</SurveyEyebrow>
        <SurveyTitle>How do you build UI today?</SurveyTitle>
      </SurveyHeader>
      <SurveyOptions defaultValue="shared">
        <SurveyOption value="shared">A shared internal component library</SurveyOption>
        <SurveyOption value="kit">An off-the-shelf UI kit</SurveyOption>
      </SurveyOptions>
    </SurveyQuestion>
  )
}
```

## Single & multiple choice

Without a prop, `SurveyOptions` is a single choice: the DS `RadioGroup` with its canonical dot and roving focus, reporting a `string`. Add `multiple` and each row becomes a DS `Checkbox` reporting a `string[]`. The controls aren't re-styled; they're the same radio and checkbox you'd use anywhere else.

```tsx
// Single choice: circular controls, reports a string
<SurveyOptions value={source} onValueChange={setSource}>
  <SurveyOption value="copy">Copied into my repo</SurveyOption>
  <SurveyOption value="package">Installed as a package</SurveyOption>
</SurveyOptions>

// Multiple choice: square controls, reports a string[]
<SurveyOptions multiple value={priorities} onValueChange={setPriorities}>
  <SurveyOption value="a11y">Accessibility out of the box</SurveyOption>
  <SurveyOption value="theming">Theming and tokens</SurveyOption>
  <SurveyOption value="types">First-class TypeScript types</SurveyOption>
</SurveyOptions>
```

## Text, paragraph & dropdown

A question doesn't have to be a choice. `SurveyShortAnswer` composes the DS `Input`, `SurveyParagraph` the auto-growing `Textarea` (with an optional counter), and `SurveyDropdown` the `Select` for long option lists. Each is labelled by the question title automatically.

```tsx
// Short answer: composes the DS Input
<SurveyQuestion required>
  <SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyEyebrow>Question 5</SurveyEyebrow>
    <SurveyTitle>What are you building with Koala UI?</SurveyTitle>
  </SurveyHeader>
  <SurveyShortAnswer placeholder="e.g. an internal analytics console" />
</SurveyQuestion>

// Paragraph: composes the auto-growing DS Textarea
<SurveyParagraph placeholder="Tell us what’s missing…" showCount maxLength={280} />

// Dropdown: composes the DS Select
<SurveyDropdown
  options={[
    { value: "solo", label: "Just me" },
    { value: "small", label: "2 to 10 people" },
    { value: "medium", label: "11 to 50 people" },
    { value: "large", label: "51 to 200 people" },
    { value: "xlarge", label: "200+ people" },
  ]}
  placeholder="Select a team size…"
/>
```

## Linear scale

`SurveyScale` is a 1-to-N rating row built on `RadioGroup`. Set `min`/`max` and optional `minLabel`/`maxLabel` captions for the ends.

```tsx
const [rating, setRating] = useState("4")

<SurveyQuestion required>
  <SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyEyebrow>Question 8</SurveyEyebrow>
    <SurveyTitle>How easy was it to drop Koala UI into your project?</SurveyTitle>
  </SurveyHeader>
  <SurveyScale
    min={1}
    max={5}
    minLabel="Took some work"
    maxLabel="Effortless"
    value={rating}
    onValueChange={setRating}
    name="setup"
  />
</SurveyQuestion>
```

## Rating

`SurveyRating` composes the DS `Rating` for a star score, labelled by the question title. It forwards every `Rating` prop: `max`, `size`, `icon`, `readOnly`.

```tsx
const [stars, setStars] = useState(4)

<SurveyQuestion required>
  <SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyEyebrow>Question 9</SurveyEyebrow>
    <SurveyTitle>How would you rate the documentation?</SurveyTitle>
  </SurveyHeader>
  <SurveyRating value={stars} onValueChange={setStars} size="lg" />
</SurveyQuestion>
```

## Description & disabled options

Add a `SurveyDescription` under the title for context, and disable any single `SurveyOption`: keyboard navigation skips it and its row dims.

```tsx
<SurveyQuestion required>
  <SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyEyebrow>Question 4</SurveyEyebrow>
    <SurveyTitle>Pick a release channel</SurveyTitle>
    <SurveyDescription>
      Stable ships monthly. The canary channel is paused while we land v1.0.
    </SurveyDescription>
  </SurveyHeader>
  <SurveyOptions defaultValue="stable">
    <SurveyOption value="stable">Stable, updated monthly</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="next">Next, weekly previews</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="canary" disabled>Canary, paused until v1.0</SurveyOption>
  </SurveyOptions>
</SurveyQuestion>
```

## Density

`density="compact"` tightens the card padding, gaps, and row height for embedded, information-dense forms; radius and color never change. Defaults to `comfortable`, or set it once on a `DensityProvider`.

```tsx
<SurveyQuestion density="compact">
  <SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyEyebrow>Question 2</SurveyEyebrow>
    <SurveyTitle>How did you hear about Koala UI?</SurveyTitle>
  </SurveyHeader>
  <SurveyOptions defaultValue="search">
    <SurveyOption value="search">Search engine</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="social">Social media</SurveyOption>
    <SurveyOption value="friend">A friend or colleague</SurveyOption>
  </SurveyOptions>
</SurveyQuestion>
```

## Controlled

Pass `value` and `onValueChange` to own the selection. For a `multiple` group the value is a `string[]`.

```tsx
const [values, setValues] = useState(["table"])

<SurveyOptions multiple value={values} onValueChange={setValues}>
  <SurveyOption value="table">Data table</SurveyOption>
  <SurveyOption value="forms">Form controls</SurveyOption>
  <SurveyOption value="charts">Charts</SurveyOption>
  <SurveyOption value="nav">Navigation</SurveyOption>
</SurveyOptions>
```

## Composing a form

There is no Survey root or provider: every `SurveyQuestion` is a standalone card, so a survey is just the cards you need stacked inside your own `form`. Pass `name` to a single-choice `SurveyOptions`, `SurveyScale`, or a text part and the answer lands in `FormData`. A `multiple` group owns a `string[]` in React state, so serialize that one yourself.

```tsx
<Form density="comfortable" onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="max-w-xl">
  <SurveyQuestion required>
    <SurveyHeader>
      <SurveyEyebrow>Question 1 of 3</SurveyEyebrow>
      <SurveyTitle>How do you build UI today?</SurveyTitle>
    </SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyOptions name="approach" defaultValue="shared">
      <SurveyOption value="shared">A shared internal component library</SurveyOption>
      <SurveyOption value="kit">An off-the-shelf UI kit</SurveyOption>
    </SurveyOptions>
  </SurveyQuestion>

  <SurveyQuestion required>
    <SurveyHeader>
      <SurveyEyebrow>Question 2 of 3</SurveyEyebrow>
      <SurveyTitle>How easy was it to drop Koala UI into your project?</SurveyTitle>
    </SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyScale min={1} max={5} minLabel="Took some work" maxLabel="Effortless" name="setup" />
  </SurveyQuestion>

  <SurveyQuestion>
    <SurveyHeader>
      <SurveyEyebrow>Question 3 of 3</SurveyEyebrow>
      <SurveyTitle>What would make Koala UI a better fit for your stack?</SurveyTitle>
    </SurveyHeader>
    <SurveyParagraph name="notes" placeholder="Tell us what’s missing…" showCount maxLength={280} />
  </SurveyQuestion>

  <FormActions>
    <Button type="button" variant="ghost">Skip</Button>
    <Button type="submit">Submit answers</Button>
  </FormActions>
</Form>
```

## FAQ

### How do I switch SurveyOptions between single and multiple choice?

Leave SurveyOptions bare for a single choice: it renders the DS RadioGroup and reports a `string`. Add the `multiple` prop and each row becomes a DS Checkbox reporting a `string[]`. The controls are the real DS components, not restyled copies.

### Which part do I use for free text instead of choices?

`SurveyShortAnswer` composes the DS Input for one line, `SurveyParagraph` the auto-growing Textarea (pass `showCount` and `maxLength` for a counter), and `SurveyDropdown` the Select for long option lists. Each is labelled by the question title automatically.

### What is the difference between SurveyScale and SurveyRating?

`SurveyScale` is a 1-to-N linear scale built on RadioGroup: set `min` and `max` and optional `minLabel` and `maxLabel` captions for the ends. `SurveyRating` composes the DS Rating for a star score and forwards Rating props like `max`, `size`, `icon`, and `readOnly`.

### How do I mark a question as required?

Pass `required` to `SurveyQuestion` and the title renders a destructive asterisk plus an sr-only (required) note. You can override the inherited state on an individual `SurveyTitle` with its own `required` prop.

### Are the answer controls wired to the question title for screen readers?

Yes. SurveyQuestion generates a title id, and every answer part (options, short answer, paragraph, dropdown, scale, rating) is given `aria-labelledby` pointing at it, so you do not label the controls again.

### How do I make a survey card denser?

Set `density="compact"` on `SurveyQuestion` to tighten padding, gaps, and row height for embedded forms, or set it once on a `DensityProvider` for a whole subtree. Radius and color never change.

### Why does the hover highlight slide between rows?

Because it is one highlight, not a fill per row: the same travelling wash the Command palette uses, from the shared `useGlide` hook. It follows the cursor across the options and along a `SurveyScale`, moves with the keyboard focus ring, appears on the row you enter on rather than sliding in from the last one, and skips disabled rows. Selection is still carried by the control alone, so a chosen row takes no fill of its own.

### How do I submit a survey?

There is no Survey root or provider. Each `SurveyQuestion` is a standalone card, so wrap the ones you need in your own `<form>` and lay them out with a flex column. Pass `name` to a single-choice `SurveyOptions` or to `SurveyScale` and the answer lands in `FormData`; a `multiple` group owns a `string[]` in React state, so serialize that one yourself.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli add survey` writes `components/ui/survey/`. Import from `@/components/ui/survey`:

- Components and helpers: `SurveyQuestion`, `SurveyHeader`, `SurveyEyebrow`, `SurveyTitle`, `SurveyDescription`, `SurveyOptions`, `SurveyOption`, `SurveyShortAnswer`, `SurveyParagraph`, `SurveyDropdown`, `SurveyRating`, `SurveyScale`, `surveyVariants`
- Types: `SurveyQuestionProps`, `SurveyTitleProps`, `SurveyOptionsProps`, `SurveyOptionProps`, `SurveyShortAnswerProps`, `SurveyParagraphProps`, `SurveyDropdownProps`, `SurveyRatingProps`, `SurveyScaleProps`
- Koala components it installs with it: `checkbox`, `input`, `radio-group`, `rating`, `select`, `textarea`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `create-context`, `density`, `glide`, `tv`, `utils`
